name: rebuild-dossier
description: MCP server that reverse-engineers a locked rebuild spec (CLAUDE.md, .claude config, mutation-tested tests) from an existing app, so coding agents rebuild against a verified contract instead of guessing.
long_description: Before using crawl_site, run `npx playwright install chromium` once — this installs the Chromium binary Playwright needs. It's not bundled with this server, so crawl_site will fail until it's installed.

tools.name: ingest_repo
tools.description: Parse package.json, tailwind/vite config, route files, and existing tests via static analysis. No LLM call.

path.description: Absolute path to the repo to ingest

interactive.description: When true and 0 routes are found at a monorepo-shaped path, ask via elicitation which candidate directory is the real app, then ingest that instead

tools.name: crawl_site
tools.description: Playwright headless crawl of reachable routes. Emits periodic progress notifications.

repoPath.description: Repo path whose .dossier/ this crawl evidence should be saved under

tools.name: flag_known_bug
tools.description: Record a known bug. Always overrides auto-resolve for any case it matches, regardless of other evidence.

repoPath.description: Repo path whose .dossier/ this known bug belongs to

description.description: Free-text description of a known bug, stored verbatim

tools.name: get_case_queue
tools.description: Return unresolved ambiguity cases from reconciliation.

repoPath.description: Repo path whose .dossier/ case queue to read

interactive.description: When true, walk open cases via MCP elicitation instead of just listing them

tools.name: resolve_case
tools.description: Resolve one open case with a human decision. Always available, no elicitation capability required.

repoPath.description: Repo path whose .dossier/ this case belongs to

tools.name: generate_spec
tools.description: Write CLAUDE.md, .claude/, spec/, tests/, and kickoff-prompt.txt to <repo>-rebuild/. Only callable once the case queue is empty.

repoPath.description: Repo path that was ingested; output is written to a sibling <repoPath>-rebuild/ directory

authStorageStatePath.description: Optional path to a Playwright storageState JSON file for reaching auth-gated pages during capture

groq_api_key.title: Groq API Key
groq_api_key.description: Optional. Enables vision-assisted page classification in generate_spec for Next.js targets (also requires REBUILD_DOSSIER_ENABLE_VISION_CLASSIFICATION=1 set in your own environment). Leave blank to skip.
